column1: # URLs that url.Parse rejects, as RedactURL (pkg/config) and
# redactURLCredentials (pkg/apiclient) show them. Both packages run this
# table. One case per line, tab-separated: name, input, want, and a
# made-up secret that no 4-byte substring of the output may contain
all three in password, port and query
bad escape and @ after the host
space in host without user info
user name with slash and underscore
user name with slash and plus
user name with slash and equals
user name with slash and tilde
@ in the path of an IP literal host
@ in the path of a non-ASCII host
